TourAI: your AI-powered travel guide

Chat, voice, maps and GPS audio guides to explore every city at your pace. This website is the gateway to the app and your account.

The TourAI mobile app is in its final development phase. You can learn about the product here, join the launch waitlist and, if you already have an account, open My account.

Your private tour guide

TourAI acts as a local expert in your pocket. Forget crowded groups and enjoy routes adapted to your pace and curiosity.

  • Dynamic routes based on your interests.
  • Stories for every monument you visit.
  • Historical questions answered in real time.

Interact with your surroundings

Communication is key. With TourAI you can:

  • Smart chat: ask details about what you see.
  • Voice queries: search restaurants, transport or historical facts without typing.

The website is public: anyone can learn about the product. The My account area requires signing in with the same app account. If you already have an account, you can also get a plan from the dashboard.

App features

AI chat

Ask about monuments, history or local curiosities and receive contextualised answers.

Voice assistant

Control your walk and ask questions by speaking naturally.

Map and guided route

See nearby points and walk a GPS-guided route with narration at each stop.

Location-based audio guides

As you approach a point of interest, listen to narrations generated for that place.

Plans and bonuses

Plans

Temporary plans

Get 1-day, weekend or other plans to use the map, chat and audio guides with an included usage allowance.

Bonuses

Promotional bonuses

Redeem campaign codes or QR codes (welcome, birthday and others) to activate a free plan.

Languages

Spanish and English

Interface and content in Spanish (Spain) and English (United Kingdom).

Get the launch notification

The TourAI app will be published on the App Store and Google Play. Leave your email and we will notify you as soon as it is available to download.
